mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_recollection WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM review_recollection_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND recollection_id=#{id} AND id=#{versionId}
SELECT FROM review_recollection_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND recollection_id=#{id} AND recollection_version_id=#{versionId}
SELECT FROM review_recollection_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND question_id=#{questionId} AND question_version_id=#{versionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE review_recollection SET current_version_id=#{versionId},version_number=#{number}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND status='ACTIVE' AND revision<1000 AND version_number<1000 AND version_number=#{number}-1
UPDATE review_recollection SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND revision<1000 AND status<>#{status}
